name: raycast-system-temp
title: System Temperature
description: View system CPU and GPU temperature from Raycast.
author: hossammourad

commands.name: show-temperature
commands.title: Show Temperature
commands.description: Show current CPU, GPU, thermal state, and raw temperature sensors.

commands.name: menubar-temperature
commands.title: Menu Bar Temperature
commands.description: Show Mac temperature in the menu bar.

preferences.name: temperatureUnit
preferences.title: Temperature Unit
preferences.description: Unit used to display temperature values.

preferences.name: menuBarMetric
preferences.title: Menu Bar Metric
preferences.description: Temperature value shown in the menu bar.

preferences.name: showRawSensors
preferences.title: Show Raw Sensors
preferences.label: Show individual sensor readings
preferences.description: Show individual sensor readings when available.

scripts.build:helper: mkdir -p assets && clang -Wall -O2 -fobjc-arc -arch arm64 -arch x86_64 tools/temperature-reader.m -framework IOKit -framework Foundation -o assets/temperature-reader
scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
